messages:
Priya Kapoor: Quick heads-up — final loop for candidate (SDE) tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. Need coverage, scribe, and a11y note. Zoom link below. Please reply if you can cover any of these slots. :wave:

Jordan Lee: I can take the coding interview (slot 1). I'll be scribe if no one else volunteers.

Samir Patel: Can do design (slot 2). Quick Q — do we want to normalize scoring for timezone fatigue? last debrief we had a tighter range.

Maya Chen: I'll cover system tests + can be backup scribe. Also need to confirm captioning/ASL request; candidate mentioned needing captions.

Priya Kapoor: Thanks — RecruiterBot updated candidate profile with accommodation: live captions requested. We should enable auto captions in Zoom and give candidate option to opt out of recording. RecruiterBot: candidate_prefers_captions=true

Alex Rivera: Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/1234567890 passcode: redwood. Note: enable live transcript and set recording = OFF in host controls.

Jordan Lee: Quick rubric Q: are we still weighting coding 40, design 40, communication 20? Last version in docs had 35/45/20.

Priya Kapoor: Good catch. Final rubric for this loop is: coding 35, design 45, communication 20 — emphasis on system thinking for this role. Updated post here: https://confluence.redwood/internals/hiring/rubrics

Samir Patel: For scoring, let's use the shorthand: 1-4 scale per section, comments required for 1s and 4s. That'll make aggregation easier in the debrief sheet.

Maya Chen: I'll take the scribe for debrief (assuming Jordan confirms coding). Can someone pin the candidate's code repo link in the calendar invite? saves time.

Priya Kapoor: Jordan confirmed coding. Alex — you're on camera/host? Need host to enable captions and disable recording.

Alex Rivera: Yup I'll be host. Also setting a 10 min buffer between sessions to handle timezone handoff and short breaks — adding to calendar now :calendar:

RecruiterBot: Reminder queued — candidate consent recorded: no recording, captions enabled. Calendar invites sent to panel. :white_check_mark:

Priya Kapoor: Awesome. Last ask — if anyone needs to swap, ping me ASAP. Debrief doc: https://docs.redwood.com/hiring/debriefs/loop-2026-03-19

Jordan Lee: :thumbsup: See y'all tomorrow.
